item.title: Building your website in R
item.description: This website is built using the ‘blogdown’ R package, uploaded to a GitHub repo, then served to web with Netlify. Credit to the Hugo Tranquilpeak theme. One advantage is that we can write in simple R Markdown, and embed+run R code easily: HUGOMORE42 This website is built using the ‘blogdown’ R package, uploaded to a GitHub repo, then served to web with Netlify.
